Requirement: All AI systems must be registered before production use
AI tools may only be used for documented business purposes
Restricted/confidential data requires approved use-case and provider assessment
Higher-impact AI outputs require documented human review
High-impact models require documented evaluation before deployment
AI providers require security/privacy/contract review and ongoing change monitoring
Post-deployment performance and risk indicators must be monitored

Owner: privacy and model incidents must have escalation paths

Requirement: Personnel using AI must receive policy and acceptable-use training

Owner: evaluations and approvals must be retained according to approved schedules
